mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tracking_summary ( tracking_number, booking_id, shipper_id, origin_unlocode, destination_unlocode, cargo_type, transport_status, initialized_at, last_status_changed_at, projected_at, last_event_id ) VALUES ( #{trackingNumber}, #{bookingId}, #{shipperId}, #{originUnlocode}, #{destinationUnlocode}, #{cargoType}, #{transportStatus}, #{initializedAt}, #{lastStatusChangedAt}, #{projectedAt}, #{lastEventId} ) ON CONFLICT (tracking_number) DO UPDATE SET booking_id = EXCLUDED.booking_id, shipper_id = EXCLUDED.shipper_id, origin_unlocode = EXCLUDED.origin_unlocode, destination_unlocode = EXCLUDED.destination_unlocode, cargo_type = EXCLUDED.cargo_type, initialized_at = EXCLUDED.initialized_at, projected_at = EXCLUDED.projected_at

INSERT INTO tracking_leg ( tracking_number, leg_seq, voyage_number, load_unlocode, unload_unlocode, load_time, unload_time ) VALUES
(#{trackingNumber}, #{leg.legSeq}, #{leg.voyageNumber}, #{leg.loadUnlocode}, #{leg.unloadUnlocode}, #{leg.loadTime}, #{leg.unloadTime})
